plain: Competitors each cutting safety corners because they fear a rival will get there first, so everyone ends up less careful than any of them wanted.
eli5: Two kids racing to the slide both run on the wet floor, even though both know running there is how you fall.
technical: A competitive equilibrium among AI developers or states in which each reduces safety investment to avoid falling behind, producing a collectively worse outcome; formalised in Armstrong, Bostrom and Shulman's “Racing to the Precipice” (2016).
